verdict.rationale: Firebase documents its own official SDKs. The Authentication SDK provides sign-in and user-management methods, the Admin SDK can trigger Cloud Functions, a Test SDK supports unit tests, and Firebase AI Logic offers client-side use across Android, iOS, Flutter, Unity and web. A community user also praises the AngularFire library. However, the pack has no SDK index, language matrix, install or reference documentation, or evidence of SDK coverage for Firestore and other services, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: a documented official SDK catalog with supported languages and platforms per service, SDK reference/install docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of building against the SDKs.
